name: Gold Token
oneLiner: GLDT is Gold DAO's fungible gold token: each token represents 0.01 grams of physical gold through locked GLD NFT backing.
collateral: GLD NFTs representing physical gold bars stored in Swiss vaults; GLDT is minted when GLD NFTs are locked in the swap canister at a ratio of 1 gram of GLD NFT backing for 100 GLDT
pegMechanism: Commodity redemption/swap model: 1 GLDT represents 0.01 grams of gold, and GLDT can be reverse-swapped into GLD NFTs when enough tokens are supplied to unlock the corresponding NFT denomination

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Gold DAO documents GLDT issuance against locked GLD NFT gold certificates, with physical gold underlying the certificates. The live claim is an issuer/protocol-managed, asset-backed commodity receipt rather than a borrower CDP, NAV fund share, or algorithmic stablecoin; within the available taxonomy, fiat-cash is the applicable direct-asset-claim archetype. Its GOLD reference remains distinct from a USD peg.

reserveReview.rationale: Re-derived 2026-07-30: the Gold DAO whitepaper fixes minting at exactly 100 GLDT per 1 g of GLD NFT locked in the swap canister, with reverse swaps burning GLDT to release the NFT, and the redemption guide confirms GLD NFTs are legal deeds for specific audited gold bars stored in Swiss vaults. DefiLlama's independent RWA profile corroborates the 100:1 backing and locked-GLD-NFT route, names Bity Tokenisation SA as the GLD NFT issuer, and cites the periodic KPMG factual-findings reports over gold held at Loomis Schweiz AG, Kloten (latest published report period 2025-09-30 covering 7.9 kg / 790 certificates; KPMG expressly frames these as agreed-upon procedures, not an assurance audit). The ICRC API read on 2026-07-30 binds the ledger's sole minting account to the Gold DAO swap canister 6f6ua-hqaaa-aaaar-qairq-cai (total supply 594,499.99 GLDT), so the locked-GLD-NFT swap is the only issuance path and the reviewed composition remains one aggregate 100% locked-gold-NFT category; this reserve classification does not establish that a GLDT holder has a direct legal claim on gold before completing the NFT swap and redemption process.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gold DAO whitepaper and redemption documentation, independently corroborated by DefiLlama's GLDT RWA profile, the KPMG factual-findings vault reports, and the on-chain minting-account binding
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The backing class is identified as locked GLD NFTs representing physical gold, but bar inventory beyond the 2025-09-30 KPMG factual-findings count, serial-level allocation, and per-bar custody shares are not disclosed in the reviewed sources.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: GLD NFTs map to specific physical gold bars with serial-level certificates, and the 2025-09 KPMG factual-findings report names Loomis Schweiz AG, Kloten as the vault operator holding 7.9 kg of gold for 790 certificates issued by Bity Tokenisation SA, supporting bar-level segregation; KPMG frames the reports as agreed-upon procedures rather than an assurance audit, and no report after 2025-09-30 is published as of 2026-07-30. The reviewed sources do not establish insolvency treatment or rehypothecation terms.

mintAuthority.summary: GLDT is minted exclusively by the Gold DAO dapp/swap canister 6f6ua-hqaaa-aaaar-qairq-cai, which the ICRC-1 ledger metadata confirms as the ledger's sole minting account; minting is economically bounded at 100 GLDT per gram of locked GLD NFT per the issuer whitepaper. Both the swap canister and the ledger are controlled by Gold DAO Root tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai, which sits in the standard SNS Root/Governance loop, so the Gold DAO SNS can upgrade the mint code and alter the bound through governance. The live code enforcing the locked-NFT rule is not independently verified, capping confidence at manual-review.

review.evidence: Follow-up 2026-07-27 resolves the 2026-07-20 open questions with reproducible primary ICP reads. (1) The ICRC API's GLDT ledger metadata returns icrc1_minting_account.owner = 6f6ua-hqaaa-aaaar-qairq-cai (total supply 59450000000000 at 8 decimals), binding the live ledger minting account to the Gold DAO dapp/swap canister. (2) The IC API enumerates the complete controller chain: the minting canister and the GLDT ledger are each controlled solely by Gold DAO Root tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai, Root is controlled by Gold DAO Governance tr3th-kiaaa-aaaaq-aab6q-cai, and Governance is controlled by Root — the standard SNS loop, so the Gold DAO SNS is the only authority that can alter the mint code or its economic bound, via proposal-driven canister upgrade. (3) The live code path enforcing the 100-GLDT-per-gram locked-GLD-NFT rule remains unverified at source level; the bound is taken from the issuer whitepaper, so confidence stays manual-review rather than verified. GLDT supply is backed by locked GLD NFTs representing KPMG-audited Swiss vault gold on a quarterly attestation cycle.
